page.overview:
Who is Alpha Velociraptor?

The Alpha Velociraptor was the leader of the Velociraptor pack on Isla Sorna. The Velociraptor lead the pack, like during hunting.

The raptor was the alpha of the Velociraptors on Isla Sorna. It was first seen trying to hunt an Apatosaurus, but got scared by the apatosaur's tail. The raptor was said to be the alpha by Richard Levine. It headed to the High Hide with the other raptors as they killed Eddie Carr.
